descricao: Work is understood as it really happens day to day, not just as it looks on paper, before anything is automated.
Every decision rests on data, not impressions: the cause of a problem is confirmed before anything is fixed.
Before anything changes, it is clear what could be affected and how the operation stays protected.
Changes go in short steps, with a backup and a way back: the operation keeps running while the solution goes in.
Repetitive work becomes automatic; decisions with real impact still go through a person.
What counts as success is agreed at the start and measured at the end, with the operation’s own numbers.
Everything is documented so the team can run, audit and evolve the solution without depending on whoever built it.
Every failure or one-off request becomes a lasting fix, so the same problem does not come back.
